newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares open soft, focus on Raffles.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares open soft, focus on Raffles.

text.p: Singapore shares were a touch softer at the open on Friday with most of the attention focused on newly-listed Raffles Medical Group.

Raffles shares hit a high of Singapore $0.51 against its initial offer price of S$0.38, with 16 million changing hands. That was about two thirds of the 25 million shares traded in the first 45 minutes of the day.

"Its performance is not bad at all considering the state of the market. It also did much better than others recently listed," said a dealer with a local firm. The Straits Times Industrial index was at 2,801.72, down 5.55 points.
Dealers said activity was expected to remain subdued ahead of the weekend and also U.S. retail sales data due later in the day.
Besides Raffles, several block trades were seen in early dealings including in Singapore Land, Uraco and Thakral.
Lung Kee Metal saw 590,000 shares crossed at around US$0.96. A dealer said the company had a favourable meeting with some local broking houses recently.
Early losers include DBS Land, OUB foreign and Sunright.
